newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish shares cheered by U.S. PPI data.
newsitem.headline: Swedish shares cheered by U.S. PPI data.

text.p: 1500 GMT - Swedish share prices ended higher on Wednesday after U.S. producer price data for April came in lower than expected. A downturn in debt yields outweighed the effects of a stronger crown.
* Astra rises two crowns to 315. Pharmacia & Upjohn up 2.5 crowns to 255.5, recovering after profit taking
* Volvo ends 1.5 crown higher at 208 in decent buying interest after data shows its European car registrations up 31.1 percent in April
Swedish share prices ended higher on Wednesday after U.S. producer price data for April came in lower than expected. A downturn in debt yields outweighed the effects of a stronger crown.
The general index rose 0.49 percent to 2,778.34 in turnover totalling 5.5 billion crowns.
Drug company Astra rose two crowns to 315. Rival Pharmacia & Upjohn up 2.5 crowns to 255.5, recovering from profit taking. The share ended six crowns lower on Tuesday.
Volvo closed 1.5 crown higher at 208 in decent buying interest.
The European Automobile Manufacturers Association said new registrations of Volvo cars in Europe rose 31.1 percent to 22,670 vehicles.
The banking sector index rose 0.47 percent as S-E-Banken edged up 0.5 crown to 84.
Bike company Monark Stiga rose rose 7.5 crowns to 71 after a positive newspaper article about the share.
